message.content:
I don’t have a dedicated tool to pull up documentary listings, but I can recommend a few well‑known films on global warming that you might enjoy:

| Title | Release Year | Synopsis |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** (2006) | 2006 | Former Vice President Al Gore’s presentation on climate change, later turned into a feature film. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** (2017) | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress and setbacks since the first film. |
| **Before the Flood** (2016) | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to investigate the impacts of climate change and potential solutions. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** (2019) | 2019 | A short documentary that explains the science behind climate change in an accessible way. |
| **The 11th Hour** (2007) | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, it features interviews with scientists and activists discussing environmental crises. |

These are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or YouTube Movies. Let me know if you’d like more detailed info on any particular film or help finding where to stream them!
